run_haggling_simulation: run a Concordia haggling simulation with buyers and sellers negotiating fruit prices using an LLM model
create_haggling_payoff: create a HagglingPayoff instance to score buyer and seller outcomes from price proposals and accept or reject actions
configure_negotiation_scenes: configure negotiation and decision scenes for a haggling game with buyer rewards and seller costs
create_player_pairs: create randomized buyer-seller pairs from a list of players for a haggling simulation
track_cumulative_payoff: track cumulative payoffs across multiple haggling games using a CumulativePayoff instance
